title: fluid-config static config
description: Read once at startup (config.json). Everything that changes at runtime lives in dynamic_dir.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for editor validation.

api_addr.description: Listener for the generated REST APIs.

admin_addr.description: Console and admin API listener; keep on localhost or behind a TLS reverse proxy.

api_base_path.description: Path prefix for the APIs, e.g. "/config" serves /config/v1/holidays. Requests work with or without the prefix, so a reverse proxy may strip it or not.

admin_base_path.description: Path prefix of the console, e.g. "/fluid-admin".

api_tls.description: Serve the APIs over HTTPS (certificate files or ACME).

dynamic_dir.description: Hot-reloaded directory: apis/ (one JSON file per API, sub-folders for grouping), admin.json and access.json.

reload_interval.description: How often dynamic_dir is checked for changes.

trusted_proxies.description: CIDRs or IPs of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For (walked from the right) is believed for allowlists, rate limits and logs.

max_body_bytes.description: Largest request body the API listener accepts (413 beyond).

public_catalog.description: Serve /_catalog and /openapi.json without a token (still subject to access.json catalog.allow). Default: any viewer or editor token from admin.json is required.

shutdown_timeout.description: Graceful shutdown: time in-flight requests get to finish (1s-10m).

shutdown_delay.description: After SIGTERM keep serving this long while /readyz fails, so load balancers stop sending traffic (0-5m).

database.description: SQLite store for request logs and the change history.

retention_days.description: Request logs older than this are pruned.

audit_retention_days.description: Change history older than this is pruned.

log_level.description: Minimum level stored in the log table.

capture_payloads.description: Store every API call's request and response headers and bodies (RQH, RQB, RSH, RSB). Editors see them unmasked, viewers masked.

capture_max_body_bytes.description: Per body; longer bodies are cut (the full size is recorded). 0 keeps headers only.

otlp_endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL, e.g. http://otel-collector:4318 (spans go to <url>/v1/traces). Empty: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, else tracing is off.

sample_ratio.description: Fraction of new traces sampled; a caller's traceparent decides for continued traces.

headers.description: Headers sent to the collector, e.g. an API key.

telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry tracing: one span per API request, continuing incoming traceparent headers.

tls.description: HTTPS for a listener: certificate files (reloaded when they change) or automatic ACME certificates.

acme.description: Automatic certificates (Let's Encrypt by default). TLS-ALPN-01 needs the listener on :443; otherwise set http_challenge_addr.

email.description: Contact email for the CA account.

cache_dir.description: Where certificates and the account key are kept. Default: <database dir>/acme.

directory_url.description: ACME directory, e.g. Let's Encrypt staging. Default: Let's Encrypt production.

ca_file.description: PEM roots to trust for the ACME directory (private ACME servers such as step-ca or Pebble).

http_challenge_addr.description: Listener for HTTP-01 challenges, e.g. ":80"; it also redirects other HTTP requests to HTTPS.

accept_tos.description: Must be true: you accept the certificate authority's terms of service.
